data.body: [P2] Preserve the testing-tag condition for emulator publication. `ecr-release.yml` skips image publication unless the release tag contains a `testing-v<version>` component, as its preflight logic and `test_non_testing_release_skips_without_contacting_registry` confirm. A telemetry-exporter-only release therefore publishes no emulator image. Describing publication as unconditional can cause maintainers to expect a missing image or unnecessarily modify the ECR workflow. Qualify this paragraph, the single-package instructions, and the checklist with the testing-tag requirement.
